summary: Explains the `check_mode` task option (since 2.2): `check_mode: true` always simulates and `check_mode: false` always makes changes, regardless of `--check`. Useful for testing modules with registered results; before 2.2 the equivalent of false was `always_run: true`.
questions: How do I make one task always run for real even with --check?
How do I force a task to only ever run in check mode?
How can I test whether a module would make a change without running it?

answer_card.title: Force or prevent check mode on a task
answer_card.answer_md:
Since 2.2, set `check_mode` on a task:
- `check_mode: true`: always run in check mode, even without `--check`.
- `check_mode: false`: always run normally and make changes, even with `--check`.

```yaml
- name: Always makes changes
  ansible.builtin.command: /something/to/run --even-in-check-mode
  check_mode: false

- name: Never makes changes
  ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
    line: "important config"
    dest: /path/to/myconfig.conf
    state: present
  check_mode: true
  register: changes_to_important_config
```
Registering results of `check_mode: true` tasks is handy for testing modules. Before 2.2 the equivalent of `check_mode: false` was `always_run: true`.
